description:
RainWatch answers one question at a glance: will I get wet?

It puts the rain for the next two hours on your Apple Watch face. A number counts down to the moment the rain starts or stops, and a blue shape shows how hard it will rain and for how long.

ON YOUR WATCH FACE
• A small circle: "IN 25 MIN" until rain starts, "FOR 10 MIN" while it lasts.
• A large slot with the headline and the whole two hours.
• A Smart Stack widget, and corner and inline complications.

IN THE APP
• The next two hours as a graph, with the start and end of the next shower.
• A radar map that you move through time with the Digital Crown (in the Netherlands and its neighbours).

HONEST ABOUT ITS DATA
• Every screen says when its forecast was made.
• RainWatch never counts down from a forecast that is too old. It tells you when the last one was.
• Missing data is never shown as dry.

WHERE IT WORKS
• Netherlands, Belgium, Luxembourg and western Germany: KNMI's radar forecast, two hours ahead in five-minute steps, with the radar map.
• Everywhere else: Apple Weather. Minute by minute for the next hour where Apple offers that (the UK and Ireland, for example), and hour by hour in other countries.

PRIVATE
RainWatch uses your location to find your forecast, or you can choose a place by name. Your exact position stays on your watch. There is no account, no advertising and no tracking.

Made for Apple Watch. There is no iPhone app.

Data: KNMI (CC BY 4.0) and Apple Weather.
promotionalText: Will you get wet? The rain for the next two hours where you are: on your watch face, in the Smart Stack and on a radar map.
